responsibility: Builds the memory-place categorization used by HIR type checking and later use analysis, translating expressions and patterns into typed `Place` structures with explicit dereferences, projections, indexing, mutability, and upvar access. It provides the shared `MemCategorizationContext` that `expr_use_visitor` and closure/upvar analysis use to understand whether a value is an rvalue, local, field, dereference, or captured variable, and to walk patterns against the corresponding memory locations.
